info.title: Nutanix Multidomain Versioned APIs
info.description: Manage all Nutanix services running on the Nutanix Cloud Platform (NCP) deployed in on-prem data centers ,Nutanix Cloud Clusters (NC2) or edge sites.

tags.name: ExternalRepositories
tags.description: A repository of data that is external to AOS, accessible over a specified protocol (for example, NFSv3) - typically identified by the IP address at which the storage is available on the network and optionally a relative path from the root of the storage system.

tags.name: Projects
tags.description: A project is a logical namespace established within the Nutanix ecosystem, to organize infrastructure entities for different departments, business units, or tenants. Its primary function is to facilitate collaboration by enabling shared access to the same underlying infrastructure while ensuring resource isolation, access controls, security, and compliance.

tags.name: ContentRepositories
tags.description: It allows user to create container objects in the form of Repository Items for VM disk images. Content Repositories are used to store VM disk images, and Repository Items are used to reference VM disk images within a Content Repository.

tags.name: RegisteredDomains
tags.description: The registered domain APIs allow users to configure and manage registered domains in Nutanix Central. Users can create, list, fetch, update, and delete these domains.

tags.name: Locations
tags.description: The locations in Nutanix Central represent geographical position. Entities that need to be bound to geographical position can refer to this.

tags.name: LocalDomain
tags.description: The local domain APIs allow users to fetch and perform operations on the local domain. Users can execute fetch, register, and deregister operations within the local domain.
